title: Consumer Care Note — Tolling of the Payment Arrangements Term After a Hardship Hold
content:
The term of a plan under Payment Arrangements is tolled, for a re-aging after a hardship suspension, according to the hardship hold that suspended the plan.

## Rule

The hold is the one on the plan's account whose decision date is the plan's suspended date, as recorded under Hardship and Protective Holds, with its ended date and its tier's documentation requirement.

- A hold of a tier that needs documentation and that ended no more than 90 days before the handling date tolls the term by 30 days.
- A self-attested hold (a hold whose tier does not need documentation) that ended no more than 90 days before the handling date tolls it by 15 days.
- Any other case tolls it by 0 days.

The 90 days are calendar days from the hold's ended date to the handling date; a hold that ended exactly 90 days before the handling date is still within them. A hold with no ended date is "any other case".

## Grid

| Tier of the hold | Hold ended, relative to the handling date | Term tolling |
|---|---|---|
| Needs documentation | 90 days or fewer before | 30 days |
| Self-attested | 90 days or fewer before | 15 days |
| Either | More than 90 days before, or not ended | 0 days |

## Hypothetical cases (handling date 1 October)

- Documented hold ended 3 July (90 days before): 30 days.
- Documented hold ended 2 July (91 days before): 0 days.
- Self-attested hold ended 15 September: 15 days.
